text: This picture shows a map of Africa. The highlighted country is Ghana.

atoms.text: Ghana is a very beautiful country with a rich history and culture. It is located in Africa. More precisely, Ghana is in West Africa with a coastline on the Atlantic Ocean.
atoms.sound: Ghana is a very beautiful country with a rich history and culture. It is located in Africa. More precisely, Ghana is in West Africa with a coastline on the Atlantic Ocean.

atoms.text: The word Ghana means warrior king, a name which relates to the former Ghanaian Empire. The people in Ghana speak many different languages. Aside from English, which is the official language, many people also speak languages like Akan or Ewe.

atoms.sound: ssml: A couple of days later, Peter finds a newspaper article about Ghana. Select the butterfly to see the text.

atoms.text: Ghana is famous for many things. For instance, it has a lot of natural resources, like gold and iron. It also has beautiful landscapes and fascinating animals. For example, there are over 650 butterfly species in Ghana, including the giant swallowtails.
This type of butterfly can be up to 7 inches long. In Ghana, butterflies are a symbol of wealth and elegance, which are both important in Ghanaian culture.
